title: Channel Maintenance in Chollas Creek
description:
Hard work in the hot summer months will pay off when storm season arrives. Stormwater Department crews, along with our partners at Urban Corps, just finished maintenance on this channel in City Heights. Infrastructure maintenance is especially important this year with a strong El Niño weather system in the forecast.  

Residents are also encouraged to prepare ahead of storm season. Find tips and resources at the City’s new El Niño webpage: sandiego.gov/elnino.
